acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p jmap-mail-server capability passes; clippy clean; JMAP_MAIL_URI etc. accessible from lib.rs
description:
RFC 8621 §1.3: Servers must advertise capabilities under exact IANA URIs: 'urn:ietf:params:jmap:mail', 'urn:ietf:params:jmap:submission', 'urn:ietf:params:jmap:vacationresponse'. jmap-mail-server has no constants for these URIs. Consuming server authors must look up the URIs themselves.

Algorithm:
1. In src/lib.rs add at top of file:
   pub const JMAP_MAIL_URI: &str = "urn:ietf:params:jmap:mail";
   pub const JMAP_SUBMISSION_URI: &str = "urn:ietf:params:jmap:submission";
   pub const JMAP_VACATION_RESPONSE_URI: &str = "urn:ietf:params:jmap:vacationresponse";
2. Add /// doc comments citing RFC 8621 §1.3 for each constant
3. In tests/integration.rs add:
   - test capability_uri_mail_matches_rfc: assert JMAP_MAIL_URI == 'urn:ietf:params:jmap:mail'
   - test capability_uri_submission_matches_rfc: same for submission URI
   - test capability_uri_vacation_response_matches_rfc: same for vacationresponse URI

Defensive rules: these are string constants, no runtime risk. Use &str not String to avoid allocation.

Tests: 3 tests, each asserting the exact RFC-mandated URI string. Oracle: RFC 8621 §1.3 lines 260, 350, 408.
title: jmap-mail-server: document and test RFC 8621 capability URIs
